title: Morning Video Frame Thumbnail
tests: Tests extracting a usable frame from an attached video and composing it with readable text into a still thumbnail.

judge.summary: A clean, warm thumbnail pairs the recognisable, smiling woman with a large, easily readable headline beside her face.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is one still image in 16:9, not a video.
must_haves.why: The output is a single widescreen thumbnail image.

must_haves.item: The thumbnail visibly uses a frame from talk-one.mp4, retaining the woman's identity and source-frame appearance.
must_haves.why: The woman remains recognisable, with the same hairstyle, grey top, smiling expression, and hands-together pose as the supplied frame.

must_haves.item: The woman's face is clear and unobstructed.
must_haves.why: Her face is prominently displayed, sharp, and free of overlapping text or objects.

must_haves.item: The headline reads exactly “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in large, legible letters beside her face.
must_haves.why: The exact headline appears in large white lettering on the left, beside the woman.

must_haves.item: The overall treatment looks warm and upbeat.
must_haves.why: The warm neutral background, bright presentation, and broad smile create a friendly, upbeat mood.
